duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَإِسْرَافَنَا فِي أَمْرِنَا وَثَبَتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَأَنصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanagh fir landa zunaobanga wa israafanaa feee amrinaa wa sabbit aqdaamanaa wansurmaa alal qawmill kaafireen
duas.translation: Our Lord! Forgive us our sins and anything We may have done that transgressed our duty: Establish our feet firmly, and help us against those that resist Faith

duas.arabic: لا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ... فَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
duas.transliteration: Laa yukollitul-laahu nafsan illaa wus'ahaa ... fansurnaa alal qawmil kaafireen
duas.translation: On no soul doth Allah Place a burden greater than it can bear... Thou art our Protector: Help us against those who stand against faith.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَثَبَتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَأَنصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaaa afrigh alainaa sabranw wa sabbit aqdaamanaa wansurnaa 'alal qawmil kaafireen
duas.translation: Our Lord! Pour out constancy on us and make our steps firm: Help us against those that reject faith.

duas.arabic: رَّبِّ أَدْخِلْنِي مُدْخَلَ صِدْقٍ ... وَاجْعَل لِي مِن لَّدُنكَ سُلْطَنَا نَّصِيرًا
duas.transliteration: Rabbi adkhilnee mudkhala sidqinw wa akhrijnee mukhraja sidqinw wajal lee milladunka sultaanan naseera
duas.translation: O my Lord! Let my entry be by the Gate of Truth and Honour... grant me from Thy Presence an authority to aid (me).

duas.arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَا أَنزَلْتَ إِلَى مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقير
duas.transliteration: Rabbi innee limaa anzalta ilayya min khairin faqeer
duas.translation: O my Lord! truly am I in (desperate) need of any good that Thou dost send me!

duas.arabic: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّن لِّسَانِي يَفْقَهُوا قَوْلِي
duas.transliteration: Rabbish rah lee sadree. Wa yassir leee amree. Wahlul uqdatan milli saanee yafqahoo qawlee
duas.translation: O my Lord! expand me my breast, ease my task for me, and remove the impediment from my speech, so they may understand what I say.

duas.arabic: رَّبِّ أَنزِلْنِي مُنزَلًا مُبَارَكًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الْمُنزِلِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi anzilnee munzalan mubaarakanw wa Anta khairul munzileen
duas.translation: O my Lord! enable me to disembark with Thy blessing, for Thou art the Best to enable (us) to disembark.

duas.arabic: أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ الضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: Annee massaniyad durru wa Anta arhamur raahimeen
duas.translation: Truly distress has seized me, but Thou art the Most Merciful of those that are merciful.
